name: tsgolint-rust-workspace
description: The development workspace of tsgolint-rust: the turbo tasks, the e2e suite and the rule fixtures. The published package is in npm/.
author: tunnckoCore

scripts.build: cargo build --release -p tsgolint-rust && cargo build --release --target wasm32-wasip1 -p tsgolint-rust
scripts.check: node npm/scripts/packages.mjs check && cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
